title: Hydration and Fat Metabolism
excerpt: Did you know that adequate hydration is necessary for fat metabolism?
author: Devon RD
bodyHtml:
Did you know that adequate hydration is necessary for fat metabolism?

All too often we focus on what we eat and yet forgetting about liquids could be holding your weight loss back. Beverages such as calorie free sports drinks, herbal tea, coconut water, broth, and obviously water are all great ways to hydrate yourself.

What are some of your favorite ways to stay hydrated?
